gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-literata: LXGW WenKai TC writes with a loose, graceful pen whose pressure never shifts from letter to letter. Literata, a text serif, adds a faint tug between its heavy verticals and lighter horizontals, giving the page some structure.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-bespoke-sans: Mynerve looks hand-drawn and friendly, every stroke cut to a single width, each c left visibly open. Bespoke Sans is sharper and refined, and the gap between those two temperaments is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-literata: Literata is a bookish serif with a modest rhythm of heavy and light strokes. Mynerve sits against it with relaxed, hand-drawn letters whose crossbars are as fat as their stems, and that friction is the real draw.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-bespoke-sa: Marker-like lines, bent from a single length of tubing. Bespoke Sans takes over below with sharp, refined plain sans letters and generous space where curves meet the stem, so the casual top never feels sloppy.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-literata: Plain marker lines, relaxed and graceful. Literata, a serif, gives the answer with sturdy thin strokes and slightly heavier verticals; one is all casual pen, the other is quietly bookish and sophisticated.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-archivo: Thin steel-rod letters hold their thickness all the way through each curl, loose and personal. Archivo adds a commanding x-height beneath, making the pair feel casual yet confident.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-fs-asap: Wire-thin, pen-and-paper letters with no calligraphic swell give Over the Rainbow its personal air. Asap follows in a plain sans, readable and professional, with a body height that nearly matches its capitals, so paragraphs stay tidy and easy going.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-fs-epilogue: Casual and personal, Over the Rainbow bends thin steel-rod letters with a shallow curl. And Epilogue, with its curvy, wire-like monoline skeleton and stubby ascenders, shares that wiry spirit, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-fs-erode: Erode reads dignified and editorial, with a gentle ebb in its stroke weight. Over the Rainbow brings tubular, wire-like letters above it, so the page feels both handwritten and settled.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-fs-fira-sans: A loose, personal hand made of thin steel rod, with a wide shallow curl on every terminal. Over the Rainbow is the casual voice here, while Fira Sans stays clean and sturdy.
